data.body_html:
The F1 Grand Prix 2046 is set to be the biggest motorsport event of the year, and Marbella is the perfect base to enjoy it in style. Instead of fighting the crowds on land, why not watch the action from the deck of a private boat? With departures from Puerto Banús, you can combine the thrill of the race with the luxury of the Costa del Sol. Here's everything you need to know about renting a boat for the F1 weekend – from pricing to the best boats and itineraries.

Why choose a boat for the F1 weekend?

Marbella transforms during the F1 Grand Prix weekend. Hotels fill up, beach clubs get crowded, and traffic on the Golden Mile can be a nightmare. A boat gives you a private, air-conditioned escape – you can anchor in a quiet cove, enjoy the sea breeze, and still be part of the action. Plus, you get front-row seats to the sunset over La Concha, with a glass of cava in hand.

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes from Marbella Marina. You can choose from a range of vessels, from sporty speedboats to 29-metre superyachts. Whether you're a couple or a group of 12, there's a boat that fits your needs.

Our fleet for the F1 weekend

We have 17 boats in our fleet, all based in Puerto Banús. Here are the most popular choices for the F1 weekend:

Pricing and what's included

We keep pricing transparent. For the F1 weekend, our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. The Tier B Mangusta 80 (both white and grey) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, and includes a jet ski for free. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp – just ask for a quote.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras – the price you see is the price you pay.

Best spots to anchor during the race

While the actual F1 circuit is not in Marbella, you can still enjoy the race weekend in style. Anchor near Cabopino for a relaxed vibe, or head to Cala del Faro for a more secluded spot. Cala Cortés is another favourite – crystal-clear water and plenty of space.

If you want to be close to the action, stay near Puerto Banús – you'll be in the middle of the evening parties and celebrity spotting. The skipper can recommend the best anchorage based on wind and sea conditions.

Sample itinerary for race day

Here's how to make the most of your F1 boat day:

  • 11:00 – Depart Puerto Banús, cruise along the coast towards Cabopino.
  • 12:00 – Anchor for a swim and enjoy the included snacks and drinks.
  • 14:00 – Set up a screen on deck to watch the F1 race live (you can bring your own tablet or use your phone).
  • 16:30 – After the race, cruise back to Puerto Banús for the post-race celebrations.
  • 19:00 – Dock at Marbella Marina and continue the evening at a beach club.

This itinerary works perfectly on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. For larger groups, the Azimut 58 Flybridge offers plenty of space for a party.

How to book for the F1 weekend

Booking is simple. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and group size. We'll confirm availability and send you a quote. For the F1 weekend (expected 5-7 May 2046), we recommend booking at least 3-4 months in advance – the fleet sells out fast.

Check our blog for more tips on Marbella boat rentals, or browse the full fleet to start planning.

Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to rent a boat for the F1 Grand Prix weekend in Marbella?

For the F1 weekend, our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and includes a jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

Which boats are best for a group of 10-12 people during the F1 weekend?

For groups up to 12, we recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). These have plenty of deck space for viewing and socialising. If you're a smaller group, the Fairline Targa (10 pax) or Pershing 46 (10 pax) work well.

Can we watch the F1 race from the boat?

You won't see the actual circuit from Marbella – the race is in Jeddah or another venue. But you can watch the live broadcast on a large screen or tablet while anchored in a scenic spot like Cabopino or Cala del Faro. Many guests enjoy the race with the sea breeze and champagne, then head to Puerto Banús for the evening celebrations.

Do we need to book early for the F1 weekend?

Absolutely. The F1 Grand Prix weekend is one of the busiest of the year in Marbella. Our fleet books out 3-4 months in advance. To secure your preferred boat, we recommend reserving as soon as you have your dates confirmed – ideally by January 2046.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs – the price you see is the price you pay. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is also included free.

Can we customise the itinerary for the F1 weekend?

Yes. You can plan your day with the skipper – for example, a morning cruise to Cabopino, anchoring for a swim at Cala Cortés, then an afternoon watching the race live on board. Evenings can be spent at Puerto Banús or Marbella Marina. Just let us know your preferences when booking.

What is the cancellation policy?

We understand plans can change. For the F1 weekend, we ask for a 50% deposit at booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. If you cancel more than 30 days in advance, we offer a full refund. Within 30 days, the deposit is non-refundable, but you can reschedule for a future date subject to availability.

Are there any extra costs for fuel or docking?

No. Fuel is included in all our charters, as are docking fees at Puerto Banús. The only optional extras are additional food or premium beverages, which you can arrange with the skipper in advance. For the Mangusta 80, the jet ski is free, but fuel for the jet ski is extra if you use it extensively.

Ready to make your F1 Grand Prix 2046 weekend unforgettable? Book your Marbella boat rental today and secure the best spot on the water.
